systems.owner: Government of Madagascar, under the World Bank-funded PRODIGY project
systems.tiers: national enrolment, including mobile teams in hard-to-access areas; more than six million enrolled as of June 2026 by the authorities' count, against a goal of 12 million

systems.system: AI-powered digitisation of civil registration records
systems.tiers: over 10 million civil registration records digitised, said to have accelerated ID enrolment

note: Identity enrolment and a back-capture of existing civil registration records only; no system in which an office makes the digital record of a birth or death.
